main_text.p: & situm frequenter ac uarie mutant. Hanc diuersitatem ac uarietatem in singulorum motibus accidere, stata tamen atq; immota lege recurrere obseruationes docent ac conuincunt. Cum uero certissimum sit integras periodos singulorum orbium perpetuo congruere, ne irregularitas concedatur aliqua in motibus cœlestibus: saluant hæc φαινό-μενα alij alijs hypothesibus constitutis & assumptis orbibus eccentricis atq; Epicyclis seu pluribus seu paucioribus, & ex his demonstrationes extruunt, quibus uarietatis huius causas ostendunt, quas hypotheses Theoricarum libelli & artificum opera proponunt & explicant, inde studiosi petant.
Alterius enim loci est tractatio de motibus planetarum & octauæ sphæræ.

page.notes: Greek line "τέλος, θεῷ δόξα." is printed in a stylised form; the transcription follows the letters as read. The stamp and the URL http://rcin.org.pl at the foot were omitted as not printed matter of the book.
